title: pvTetrahedralize
body:
## pvTetrahedralize

Splits all 3-D cells into tetrahedra and 2-D cells into triangles, producing an unstructured grid; point data are unchanged and cell data are copied to the pieces. Use it when a later step or export needs simplices only. ParaView warns on creation because the cell count can grow several-fold.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A hexahedral mesh becomes several times as many cells; check memory before running on large meshes.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Tetrahedralize`. Identity: `filters/DataSetTriangleFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Tetrahedralize filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData); rectilinear grids (vtkRectilinearGrid); curvilinear structured grids (vtkStructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkImageData","vtkRectilinearGrid","vtkStructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
